stations.title: Theo
stations.say: Why did 3 plus one come out 31?

stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: Text and blanks read as they are

captions: Rules give yes or no. Now Theo wants the evening's order form read properly.
The form sends text and empty boxes, so 3 plus one comes out as 31.
You turn text into numbers and fill the gaps, in four small tasks.
Now the quantity adds up, empty notes get a default and bad numbers are caught.
Null, undefined and NaN in hand. Your first day at the shop is done.
